title: Beginner Saxophone Lessons
body: An introduction to the saxophone for new students: embouchure, tone, breathing, and your first tunes. No prior experience required. Mondays and Saturdays at Crossroads Conservatory in the Crossroads Arts District.

title: Intermediate Saxophone Lessons
body: Builds your sound with scales, improvisation over standards, and ensemble listening. Wednesday evenings with founder Jessica Webb. Prerequisite: one year of study or instructor approval.

title: Youth Jazz Combo Ages 8-14
body: A joyful introduction to playing in a group for young musicians. Saturday mornings. Focuses on rhythm, listening, and playing together, with a recital performance in December.

title: Adult Jazz Ensemble
body: Thursday evening placement-based ensemble for experienced adult players. Current cycle: bebop heads and ballads, with coaching from quartet pianist Ray Coleman and bassist Luke Vance.

title: Crossroads 5th Anniversary Showcase October 10 2026
body: An evening of student and faculty performances celebrating five years of Crossroads Conservatory. Live at The Phoenix in Kansas City. Doors at 6pm; performance at 7pm.

title: Annual Holiday Recital December 19 2026
body: Students from every program perform at the Crossroads Conservatory annual holiday recital. All levels welcome to participate. Doors open at 6pm.
